## ZBoard v0.0.3 Release Candidate

Changes since [v0.0.3-rc.202611190139](https://github.com/zerodenet/zboard/releases/tag/v0.0.3-rc.202611190139).

- Renaming a protocol keeps its confirmed delivery and subscription visibility when the effective configuration is unchanged.
- When credential preparation encounters a temporary conflict before configuration is applied, a copied protocol stays in its original delivery task. Completed group steps are retained, and the node step resumes before making the protocol available in subscriptions.
- The subscription template preview uses the shared read-only text control. The full frontend suite runs in CI again.

- Retention and credential-expiry tests use the intended fixture dates so the same checks run throughout the release cycle.

### Upgrade

This candidate adds no database migrations since the preceding RC. For upgrades from earlier versions, back up the database and deployment configuration before starting ZBoard. Pin the exact RC image tag or verify the Linux amd64 archives against `SHA256SUMS`.

## 简体中文

本版汇总 [v0.0.3-rc.202611190139](https://github.com/zerodenet/zboard/releases/tag/v0.0.3-rc.202611190139) 以来的变更。

- 协议实际配置相同时，改名会保留已有交付确认，订阅继续包含该协议。
- 复制协议后，如果凭据准备在下发前遇到短暂冲突，原任务会保留已完成的节点组步骤，并继续处理目标节点。新协议在节点确认应用配置后进入订阅。
- 订阅模板预览使用共用的只读文本控件。前端完整测试套件已恢复到 CI。

- 计量保留与凭据到期回归使用与测试数据一致的时钟，避免测试随发版日期失效。

### 升级

本次 RC 沿用上一候选版的数据库迁移。从更早的版本升级前请备份数据库和部署配置。部署时请固定到准确的 RC 镜像标签，或使用 `SHA256SUMS` 校验 Linux amd64 下载包。
